ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2001_100_10:
What’s up, [Name:PlayerNickname ]?
Something on your mind?
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2002_100_10:
You’re here, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Let’s take it easy.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2003_100_10:
With you around, I feel like we can solve
anything that comes our way,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2101_100_10: Here—let me greet you with a gift!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2101_200_10:
I’m glad you like it! Looks like I made the
right choice!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2102_100_10:
Here, I’ll give you this! It should come in
handy.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2102_200_10:
Next time we’ve reason to celebrate, I’ll get
you something even better!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2103_100_10:
There you are, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Here’s an extra-special present!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2103_200_10:
I wanted to thank you for always lending
me a hand.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2103_300_10:
So I put my gratitude into that gift! I bet it’ll
help you out!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2201_100_10: All right! Let’s have a chat!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2202_100_10:
Hey, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
Feeling ready for a little chat?
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2203_100_10:
Just let me know if you ever need help.
I’m here for you anytime,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2301_100_10:
Are you for real? I can have something this
awesome?!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2301_200_10:
All right—next time, I’ll give you something
awesome in return! That’s a promise!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2402_100_10:
OK, should we call it here? That was fun.
Let’s chat again soon!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2401_100_10:
It’s strange. I feel like you and I can talk
about anything, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8201_2401_200_10:
Setting aside time for heart-to-hearts is
important. Let’s talk again soon!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8001_0701_100_10:
This place is so comfortable. Everyone looks
like they’re having a great time!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8001_0701_200_10:
And there’s so much attention to detail in the
cleaning and hospitality.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8001_0701_300_10:
I wanna run a hotel on Pasio one day, so 
I can learn a lot from this place!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8002_0701_100_10:
For a signature dish to be famous, it’s gotta
make a splash.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8002_0701_200_10:
That’s why my croissant curry is next level.
Its presentation isn’t the only thing that’ll
shock you—it’s also surprisingly tasty!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8002_0701_300_10:
It’s the pride of Hotel Z! Try it once and
you’ll never forget it!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8003_0701_100_10:
When I open a Hotel Z on Pasio, I’ve gotta
make it the best hotel ever.
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8003_0701_200_10:
I don’t just want it to bear the Hotel Z name.
It needs top-notch food and service. I can’t
compromise on anything!
ch0367_00_gai_salon/8003_0701_300_10:
That means I’ll need lots of help to make its
service and advertising perfect!
